title: Pure Meklord
summary: The pure Meklord Machine build with generic Rank 4 Xyz, Links, and staples. The strategy destroys its own face-up monsters by card effect to trigger the Meklord Emperors from the hand and summon replacements from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Meklord Nucleus Infinity Core searches any Meklord Spell or Trap on summon, and Special Summons a Meklord Emperor from the hand or Deck ignoring its summoning conditions when destroyed by card effect.
Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato destroys itself on the field to Special Summon two Meklord Army monsters from the Deck in Defense Position.
Meklord Assembly searches any Meklord monster on activation, and can discard a card to destroy a monster you control—triggering Infinity Core and the Meklord Emperors.

summary.title: Opening: Infinity Core + Assembly into Emperors & Triskelion
steps: Normal Summon Meklord Nucleus Infinity Core to search Meklord Assembly (or Meklord Astro the Eradicator if you already opened Assembly).
Activate Meklord Assembly to search Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato or Meklord Emperor Wisel - Synchro Absorption.
Use Meklord Assembly's second effect to discard a card and destroy Infinity Core; Infinity Core summons Meklord Emperor Wisel from the Deck while triggers in your hand let you deploy another Emperor.

Normal or Special Summon Obbligato and destroy it to summon two Level 4 Meklord Army monsters for Rank 4 or Link plays, or fuel the GY with three differently named Meklords for Meklord Astro Dragon Triskelion.

summary.title: Self-Destruction & Synchro Absorption
summary.text: Meklord Emperor Wisel, Skiel, and Granel each Special Summon themselves from the hand whenever a face-up monster you control is destroyed by a card effect, and once per turn they can equip an opponent's face-up Synchro Monster to gain its ATK. Meklord Emperor Wisel - Synchro Absorption can be Special Summoned during the opponent's turn by sending a face-up Meklord you control to the GY, stopping an opposing monster from attacking or Tributes itself to negate any destruction effect.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Meklord Astro Dragon Triskelion Special Summons itself by banishing 3 differently named Meklords from your GY, and looks at the opponent's Extra Deck on attack declaration to equip 1 monster from it and gain its ATK (plus 3 attacks if it was a Synchro).

Meklord Emperor Wisel negates an opponent's Spell card activation once per turn, while Meklord Astro Dragon Asterisk gains the combined ATK of your Meklords and burns the opponent whenever a Synchro is summoned.
Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato and Meklord Astro the Eradicator lock you into Machine Special Summons for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Meklord Deflection destroys a Meklord you control so another Meklord gains the combined original ATK of all Meklords on your field, and banishes itself from the GY to protect a Meklord from destruction.

Meklord Astro the Eradicator targets 3 differently named Meklords in your GY to add them to your hand or Special Summon them, and destroys a Synchro Monster to inflict its original ATK as burn damage.
Mektimed Blast destroys 1 Meklord monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls simultaneously.
